frequency_question: How often do state supreme courts rule to allow a contested map before the statutory ballot deadline in expedited pre-election litigation?
membership_rule: Includes state supreme court level challenges to congressional or legislative maps filed within 60 days of an impending election cycle where courts issued expedited rulings. Excludes federal court litigation and non-redistricting emergency stays.
